title: Enact Ohio Property Protection Act
description: To amend sections 319.202, 5301.256, and 5323.02 of the Revised Code to modify the law that prohibits certain governments, businesses, and individuals from acquiring certain real property and to name this act the Ohio Property Protection Act.

title: Establish the Child Care Cred Program
description: To enact section 5104.54 of the Revised Code to establish the Child Care Cred Program and to make an appropriation.

title: Enact the School Bus Safety Act
description: To amend sections 4503.03, 4510.036, 4511.75, 4511.751, and 4511.76 and to enact sections 5.501, 3327.18, and 3327.19 of the Revised Code to address school bus safety, to designate this act as the School Bus Safety Act, and to make an appropriation.

title: Designate Ohio Stillbirth Prevention Day
description: To enact section 5.2471 of the Revised Code to designate September 19 as "Ohio Stillbirth Prevention Day."

title: Enact the Repeat Offender Act
description: To amend sections 109.11, 109.57, 109.572, 109.578, 109.579, 2151.357, 2746.02, 2901.08, 2923.125, 2923.13, 2923.14, 2929.01, 2929.13, 2929.14, 2929.34, 2930.171, 2941.141, 2941.144, 2941.145, 2941.146, 2951.041, 2953.25, 2953.26, 2953.31, 2953.32, 2953.34, 2953.39, 2953.61, 4723.28, 4729.16, 4729.56, 4729.57, 4729.96, 4752.09, and 5120.035 and to enact sections 2941.1427, 2941.1428, 2941.1429, 2953.311, 2953.321, 2953.322, and 2953.323 of the Revised Code to enact the Repeat Offender Act to create a repeat offender classification, to create and modify certain firearm specifications, to increase the penalties for certain firearm offenses and specifications, to broaden the scope of relief from firearms disability, and to modify the Sealing and Expungement Law.

title: Enact Advance Ohio Higher Education Act
Make certain caregivers eligible for publicly funded child care
description: To amend section 5104.30 and to enact section 5104.302 of the Revised Code to make foster caregivers and kinship caregivers eligible for publicly funded child care.

title: Require health plan and Medicaid coverage of biomarker testing
description: To enact sections 3902.65 and 5164.13 of the Revised Code to require health benefit plan and Medicaid program coverage of biomarker testing.

title: Replace interstate construction requirement with a traffic study
description: To repeal section 5501.60 of the Revised Code to replace the requirement that the Department of Transportation construct certain interstate interchanges with a traffic congestion study.

title: Regulate imitation meat and egg products
description: To amend sections 909.07, 921.01, 921.06, 921.11, 921.16, 921.24, 943.26, 3314.03, 3326.11, 3328.24, 3701.132, and 3715.60 and to enact sections 3313.8110, 3345.88, 3715.601, 3715.602, 3715.603, 3715.604, 3715.605, and 5101.5410 of the Revised Code to regulate imitation meat and egg products and to revise various agriculture laws.

title: Regards legislative rule approval and fiscal analyses of rules
description: To amend sections 106.02, 106.023, 106.024, 111.15, 119.03, and 119.04 and to enact sections 106.025, 106.026, 106.033, 106.10, 121.96, and 126.04 of the Revised Code to require legislative approval of administrative rules and other regulatory actions under specified conditions, to allow a JCARR chairperson to request a third-party fiscal analysis of a rule, and to require state agencies to publicly post policy documents.

title: Enact the Jeff, Dave, and Angie Patient Right to Try Act
description: To enact section 3792.08 of the Revised Code regarding prescribing, dispensing, and administering drugs and to name this act the Jeff, Dave, and Angie Patient Right to Try Act.

title: Designate Roy Rogers Day
description: To enact section 5.267 of the Revised Code to designate November 5th as "Roy Rogers Day."

title: Incorporate Internal Revenue Code changes into Ohio law
description: To amend section 5701.11 of the Revised Code to expressly incorporate changes in the Internal Revenue Code since March 15, 2023, into Ohio law and to declare an emergency.

title: Amend competitive retail electric service law
Prohibit certain restrictions on display of political yard signs
description: To amend section 5301.072 of the Revised Code to prohibit certain restrictions on the display of political yard signs.

title: Regards tax classification of certain storage condominiums
description: To amend section 5713.041 of the Revised Code to classify certain storage condominiums as residential property for tax purposes.

title: Enact the Ohio Strategic Cryptocurrency Reserve Act
description: To amend sections 145.11, 742.11, 3307.15, 3309.15, 3770.06, and 5505.06 and to enact section 135.146 of the Revised Code to address investments in exchange-traded products by the state retirement systems, to permit the Treasurer of State to invest certain interim funds in digital assets, and to name this act the Ohio Strategic Cryptocurrency Reserve Act.

title: Regards underage possession or consumption of alcohol
description: To amend section 4301.69 of the Revised Code to reduce the mental state, from knowingly to recklessly, that applies to the prohibition against allowing an underage person to possess or consume alcohol in a private or public place.

title: Prohibit harassing or impeding an emergency service responder
description: To amend sections 2903.22 and 2921.31 of the Revised Code to increase the penalty for obstructing official business when the victim is an emergency service responder who is engaged in the lawful performance of a legal duty and to clarify that heightened penalties apply for menacing a probation officer.

title: Enact the Health Care Sharing Ministries Freedom to Share Act
description: To amend sections 1716.01 and 5747.01 and to enact sections 1716.22 and 3333.96 of the Revised Code to enact the Health Care Sharing Ministries Freedom to Share Act.

title: Authorize homestead exemption for surviving military spouses
description: To amend sections 323.151, 323.152, 323.153, 4503.064, 4503.065, and 4503.066 of the Revised Code to authorize a full homestead exemption for surviving spouses of members of the uniformed services killed in the line of duty.

title: Create the escaped convict alert program
description: To amend section 4973.17 and to enact section 5502.54 of the Revised Code to create the escaped convict alert program and to allow a prior parent company of a bank to apply to the Secretary of State for the appointment and commission of banking police officers.

title: Provide Medigap policies for certain Medicare-eligible persons
description: To amend sections 3923.33, 3923.331, 3923.332, 3923.337, 3923.338, 3923.339, and 3923.42 and to enact section 3923.3310 of the Revised Code to provide Medigap policies for Medicare-eligible individuals under the age of 65.

title: Establish the Foster-to-College Scholarship Program
description: To amend sections 3314.03 and 3326.11 and to enact sections 3301.96, 3313.475, and 5103.62 of the Revised Code to enact the Fostering School Success Act.

title: Enact Protecting Ohio Communities Act
description: To amend sections 9.63, 4501.06, 5747.50, 5747.502, 5747.51, and 5747.53 and to enact sections 9.631, 9.632, 9.633, and 5747.504 of the Revised Code to require state and local authorities to cooperate with the federal government in the enforcement of immigration laws, to prescribe funding reductions for noncompliance, to name this act the Protecting Ohio Communities Act, and to declare an emergency.

title: Designate Specialist Jacob A. Ashton Memorial Bridge
description: To amend sections 4501.21 and 4503.733 and to enact section 5534.90 of the Revised Code to designate the bridge spanning the Grand River in Lake County as the "Specialist Jacob A. Ashton Memorial Bridge" and to make changes to the "Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation" license plate.

title: Eliminate the authority to levy replacement property tax levies
description: To amend sections 319.301, 319.302, 523.06, 1545.21, 3316.041, 3316.06, 3358.11, 3505.06, 5705.03, 5705.218, 5705.2111, 5705.221, 5705.233, 5705.261, and 5705.412 and to repeal section 5705.192 of the Revised Code to eliminate the authority to levy replacement property tax levies.

title: Regards inmates' access to feminine hygiene products and showers
description: To enact sections 341.261, 753.321, and 5120.631 of the Revised Code regarding inmates' access to feminine hygiene products and showers by municipal and county correctional facilities and state correctional institutions.

title: Phase-down the state income tax to a flat rate of 2.75%
description: To amend section 5747.02 of the Revised Code to phase-down the state income tax to a flat rate of 2.75% over two years.

title: Require electronic recordings of all parole board hearings
description: To amend sections 149.43, 2929.20, 5120.115, 5120.21, 5149.10, and 5149.101 and to enact section 5149.102 of the Revised Code to require electronic recordings to be made of certain parole board hearings, to make electronic recordings of full parole board hearings public records, and to provide the prosecuting attorney access to Department of Rehabilitation and Correction health care records for certain parole and judicial release cases.

title: Designate Celebrating Disabilities Month
description: To enact section 5.2322 of the Revised Code to designate the month of July as Celebrating Disabilities Month.

title: Require insurance coverage for certain prostate cancer screening
description: To enact section 3902.66 of the Revised Code to require health insurers to cover preventive screenings for certain men at high-risk for developing prostate cancer.

title: Increase the state minimum wage
description: To amend sections 4111.02, 4111.05, 4111.09, and 4111.14 and to repeal section 4111.07 of the Revised Code to increase the state minimum wage.

title: Designate the Al Oliver Highway
description: To enact section 5534.964 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of State Route 125 in Scioto County as the "Al Oliver Highway."

title: Add nitrogen hypoxia as a method of execution
description: To amend sections 2921.24, 2949.22, 2949.221, and 2949.25 of the Revised Code to add nitrogen hypoxia as a method of execution and to prohibit the disclosure of execution identifying information.

title: Designate Detective Rex Emrick Memorial Highway
description: To enact section 5534.443 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of State Route 56 in Pickaway County as the "Detective Rex Emrick Memorial Highway."

title: Designate Dr. Steven Takacs Veteran Memorial Highway
description: To enact section 5534.924 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of State Route 87 in Geauga County as the "Dr. Steven Takacs Veteran Memorial Highway."

title: Allow state income tax deduction for overtime wages
description: To amend section 5747.01 of the Revised Code to allow a state income tax deduction for overtime wages.

title: Increase disabled veteran enhanced homestead exemption
description: To amend sections 323.152 and 4503.065 of the Revised Code to increase the enhanced homestead exemption for certain disabled veterans.

title: Establish certain child care grant programs
description: To establish certain child care grant programs, including those related to child care capacity and learning labs, and to make an appropriation.

title: Require certain agencies to collect and report citizenship data
description: To amend section 3301.0714 and to enact sections 107.26, 2965.01, 2965.02, 3301.0717, 5101.546, 5107.101, and 5162.138 of the Revised Code to require certain agencies to collect and report data concerning the citizenship or immigration status of persons with whom they come into contact.

title: Waive minimum instructional hours for specified high school
description: To waive the required minimum instructional hours for Ashtabula Lakeside High School due to the school building being unusable and to declare an emergency.

title: Regards law enforcement training and competitive examinations
description: To amend sections 109.804, 124.11, and 124.30 and to enact sections 109.791 and 737.061 of the Revised Code regarding training schools for prospective law enforcement officers, filling a vacant police department position without a competitive examination, requirements for chief of police training, and advanced training for officers at or above the rank of sergeant.

title: Prohibit certain firearm transfers without a background check
description: To amend section 2923.11 and to enact section 2923.26 of the Revised Code to prohibit a federally licensed firearms dealer from transferring a firearm unless the transferee passes a background check.

title: Enact the Extreme Risk Protection Order Act
description: To amend sections 109.57, 2923.125, 2923.128, 2923.1213, and 2923.13 and to enact sections 2923.26, 2923.27, 2923.28, 2923.29, 2923.30, and 2923.99 of the Revised Code to enact the Extreme Risk Protection Order Act to allow certain persons to obtain a court order that temporarily restricts a person's access to firearms under specified circumstances.

title: Enact the Human Trafficking Prevention Act
description: To amend sections 2903.41, 2905.01, 2905.02, 2905.32, and 2971.03 of the Revised Code to enact the Human Trafficking Prevention Act to increase the penalty for human trafficking of a minor or person with a developmental disability, kidnapping, and abduction.

title: Modify tax deductions for 529 plan and ABLE account contributions
description: To amend sections 5747.70 and 5747.78 of the Revised Code to modify the income tax deductions for contributions to 529 plans and ABLE accounts.

title: Allow for creation of water improvement districts
Designate PFC John Wayne Richard Memorial Highway
description: To enact section 5533.106 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of State Route 47 in Darke County as the "PFC John Wayne Richard Memorial Highway."

title: Designate Lt. James A. Kirkendall Memorial Highway
description: To enact section 5534.427 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of U.S. Route 33 in Auglaize County as the "Lt. James A. Kirkendall Memorial Highway."

title: Revise the practice of certified registered nurse anesthetists
description: To amend sections 4723.01, 4723.43, 4723.432, 4729.01, 4731.27, 4731.35, and 4761.17; to enact new sections 4723.433 and 4723.434 and section 4731.513; and to repeal sections 4723.433, 4723.434, and 4723.435 of the Revised Code to revise the law governing the practice of certified registered nurse anesthetists.

title: Designate John Rankin Day
description: To enact section 5.295 of the Revised Code to designate February 4th as John Rankin Day, and to require a statue of John Rankin to be erected on the statehouse grounds.

title: Make appropriations for transportation for FY 2026-27 biennium
Revise fees for the administration of a probate estate
description: To amend sections 2127.38 and 5721.10 of the Revised Code to amend the law related to fees for the administration of a probate estate.

title: Designate CPL David James Amheiser Memorial Highway
description: To enact section 5534.013 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of State Route 421 in Medina County as the "CPL David James Amheiser Memorial Highway."

title: Regards school policies on administering overdose reversal drugs
description: To amend section 3313.6022 and to enact sections 3313.7119, 3313.7120, 3314.148, 3326.62, and 3328.40 of the Revised Code regarding school policies on the administration of overdose reversal drugs and limits on student attendance in released time courses in religious instruction.

title: Create recovery housing residences certificate of need program
description: To amend sections 340.034, 2925.01, 5119.01, 5119.36, 5119.365, 5119.39, 5119.392, 5119.393, 5119.394, 5119.396, 5119.94, and 5119.99; to enact new section 5119.391 and sections 5119.02, 5119.369, 5119.398, and 5119.399; and to repeal sections 5119.391, 5119.395, and 5119.397 of the Revised Code to require state certification of recovery housing residences, to establish additional duties regarding services offered by community addiction services providers, and to create the Ohio Recovery Housing Task Force.

title: Revise and streamline the state's occupational regulations
Allow use of campaign funds to pay certain child care costs
description: To amend section 3517.13 of the Revised Code to allow a candidate to use campaign funds to pay certain child care costs.

title: Modify homestead exemption, owner-occupancy tax credit amount
description: To amend sections 319.302, 323.152, 323.156, 4503.065, and 4503.068 of the Revised Code to modify the amount of the homestead exemptions and owner-occupancy property tax credit.

title: Regards the College Credit Plus Program
description: To amend sections 3365.05 and 3365.07 and to enact section 3365.072 of the Revised Code regarding the College Credit Plus Program.

title: Require ODOT to install and maintain rest stop security cameras
description: To amend section 5501.03 of the Revised Code to require ODOT to install and maintain security camera systems at rest stops.

title: Revise age for discounted hunting, fishing licenses and permits
description: To amend sections 1533.10, 1533.11, 1533.111, 1533.32, and 1533.321 of the Revised Code to allow Ohio residents who are 65 and up, instead of 66 and up, to qualify for discounted hunting and fishing licenses and permits.

title: Enact the Agriculture Appreciation Act
description: To enact sections 5.2322, 5.2411, 5.2412, 5.2413, 5.2414, 5.2415, and 5.268 of the Revised Code to make specified day and week designations relating to agriculture and to name this act the Agriculture Appreciation Act.

title: Repeal H.B. 6 - 133rd GA legacy generation resource provisions
description: To amend section 4928.01 and to repeal section 4928.148 of the Revised Code to repeal the legacy generation resource provisions of H.B. 6 of the 133rd General Assembly and provide customers refunds.

title: Establish appointment procedures for a convention of states
description: To enact sections 3523.13, 3523.14, 3523.15, 3523.16, 3523.17, 3523.18, and 3523.99 of the Revised Code to establish procedures for appointing delegates to a convention of the states under Article V of the United States Constitution.

title: Regards conceal carry locations, nonresident firearms disability
description: To amend sections 2923.123 and 2923.14 of the Revised Code to allow a concealed handgun licensee to carry a handgun in a building or structure that is not a courthouse but in which a courtroom is located in specified circumstances and to permit a nonresident of Ohio to obtain statutory relief from firearms disability based on an Ohio conviction, guilty plea, or delinquent child adjudication.

title: Regards taxpayer deduction for depreciation, enhanced expensing
description: To amend sections 5733.40, 5747.01, and 5747.05 of the Revised Code to allow taxpayers to deduct in a single year the full bonus depreciation and enhanced expensing allowances the taxpayer deducts for federal income tax purposes.

title: Regards registration, titling, and use of replica motor vehicles
description: To amend sections 4501.01, 4505.08, 4513.071, 4513.38, and 4513.41 and to enact sections 4503.183 and 4505.072 of the Revised Code to establish requirements relative to the registration, titling, and use of replica motor vehicles.

title: Require certain info disclosure for wells drilled in state parks
description: To enact section 1509.101 of the Revised Code to require horizontal oil and gas well owners that drill in state parks to disclose the chemical components of the materials used in the drilling operation.

title: Prohibit public funding for lethal injection drugs; death penalty
Establish deferred retirement option for OPERS law enforcement
description: To amend sections 145.22, 145.23, 145.35, 145.46, 145.561, and 742.63 and to enact sections 145.71, 145.72, 145.721, 145.722, 145.73, 145.74, 145.75, 145.751, 145.76, and 145.77 of the Revised Code to establish a deferred retirement option plan for law enforcement officers in the Public Employees Retirement System.

title: Authorize private vendor contract for specialty license plates
description: To amend sections 4503.038, 4503.19, and 5502.68 and to enact sections 4503.261 and 4503.262 of the Revised Code to authorize a contract with a private vendor for the issuance of specialty license plates.

title: Enact the Chief Steven DiSario Act
description: To amend sections 4781.40, 5301.072, 5311.191, and 5321.131 of the Revised Code to prohibit manufactured home park operators, condominium associations, neighborhood associations, and landlords from restricting the display of the thin blue line flag and to name this act the Chief Steven DiSario Act.

title: Allow increase in membership of boards of township trustees
description: To amend sections 505.01 and 505.82 and to enact section 505.013 of the Revised Code to allow the electors of certain townships to increase the membership of their boards of township trustees.

title: Require DOH develop type 1 diabetes information for parents
description: To amend sections 3314.03 and 3326.11 and to enact sections 3313.7118 and 3707.61 of the Revised Code to require the Department of Health to develop type 1 diabetes informational materials for parents and guardians of elementary school students.

title: Authorize use of a digital driver's license or state ID card
description: To amend section 3501.01 and to enact sections 4507.60, 4507.61, and 4507.62 of the Revised Code to authorize the use of a digital driver's license or state identification card.

title: Increase penalty for assault if the victim is a sports official
description: To amend sections 2903.13 and 2929.13 of the Revised Code to increase the penalties for assault if the victim is acting as a sports official or the assault is committed in retaliation for the victim's actions as a sports official.

title: Make appropriations for the Industrial Commission for FY 2026-27
description: To make appropriations for the Industrial Commission for the biennium beginning July 1, 2025, and ending June 30, 2027, and to provide authorization and conditions for the operation of Commission programs.

title: Make appropriations for Bureau of Workers' Comp for FY 2026-27
description: To amend sections 4121.12, 4121.121, 4121.13, 4123.44, 4123.52, 4123.54, 4123.57, 4123.66, 4125.07, 4133.10, 4167.01, 4167.10, and 5145.163 and to repeal sections 4167.25, 4167.27, and 4167.28 of the Revised Code to make appropriations for the Bureau of Workers' Compensation for the biennium beginning July 1, 2025, and ending June 30, 2027, to provide authorization and conditions for the operation of the Bureau's programs, and to make changes to the Workers' Compensation Law.

title: Regards traffic offenses in construction zones
Regards state highways located in villages and cities
description: To amend sections 5501.31, 5521.01, and 5521.011; to amend, for the purpose of adopting a new section number as indicated in parentheses, section 5521.011 (5521.012); and to enact new section 5521.011 of the Revised Code to clarify and amend the laws related to the Director of Transportation's responsibilities for state highways located in villages and cities.

title: Enact the Innocence Act
description: To amend sections 1349.10 and 1349.101 and to enact section 109.1111 of the Revised Code to establish the Innocence Act Enforcement Fund, designate specified provisions of law as the Innocence Act, and clarify the Attorney General's enforcement authority.

title: Require DAS conduct a study of the state's real property holdings
description: To enact section 123.14 of the Revised Code to require the Department of Administrative Services to conduct a biennial comprehensive study of the state's real property holdings.

title: Enact the Gus Frangos Act
Enact Strategic Tax Opportunities for Raising Kids (STORK) Act
description: To amend sections 5739.02, 5747.01, and 5747.025 of the Revised Code to authorize tax incentives for conceived children and certain child care items and to name this act the Strategic Tax Opportunities for Raising Kids (STORK) Act.

title: Regards drug trafficking, human trafficking, and fentanyl
description: To amend sections 2923.31, 2925.01, 2925.03, 2925.11, 2929.14, 3313.60, 3314.03, 3326.11, 3328.24, and 3705.08 and to enact sections 5.57, 2941.1427, 3313.6031, 3313.6032, and 3345.372 of the Revised Code to modify penalties for drug trafficking and possession, to require schools and institutions of higher education to incorporate instruction and policies on fentanyl awareness and abuse prevention, and to designate the month of August as "Fentanyl Poisoning Awareness Month."

title: Authorize temporary property tax reduction
description: To authorize a temporary property tax reduction.

title: Define antisemitism for certain purposes
description: To amend section 4112.01 and to enact sections 124.92, 2701.21, and 4112.20 of the Revised Code to define antisemitism for the purpose of investigations and proceedings in courts and state agencies and for state employee anti-bias training.

title: Establish Traumatic Brain Injury Treatment Accelerator Program
description: To enact section 3333.802 of the Revised Code to establish the Traumatic Brain Injury Treatment Accelerator Program and to make an appropriation.

title: Regards unpaid water, sewer, and trash charges at rented property
description: To amend sections 729.49, 735.29, and 743.04 and to enact sections 743.51, 743.52, 743.53, and 743.54 of the Revised Code regarding unpaid municipal utility services.

title: Restore Clean Ohio Fund and Clean Ohio Council
description: To amend section 151.40 and to enact sections 122.65, 122.651, 122.652, 122.653, 122.654, 122.655, 122.657, 122.658, and 122.659 of the Revised Code to restore the Clean Ohio Fund to be administered by the Department of Development and the Clean Ohio Council.

title: Allow employers to post certain labor law notices on the internet
description: To amend sections 4109.08, 4111.09, 4112.07, 4115.07, 4123.54, 4123.83, and 4167.11 of the Revised Code to allow employers to post certain labor law notices on the internet.

title: Support members of Ohio Veterans Education Council
description: To make an appropriation to support higher education institutions that are members of the Ohio Veterans Education Council.

title: Make state operating appropriations for FY 2026-27
Require public schools to provide meals and related services
description: To amend sections 3314.03, 3326.11, and 3328.24 and to enact section 3313.8110 of the Revised Code to require public schools to provide meals and related services to students.

title: Establish the Community Connectors Workforce Program
description: To enact section 3301.25 of the Revised Code to establish the Community Connectors Workforce Program and to make an appropriation.

title: Exclude certain agricultural entities from insurance regulations
description: To enact section 3901.96 of the Revised Code to exclude nonprofit agricultural membership organizations from insurance regulations.

title: Authorize grant program for retailers that sell donated goods
description: To authorize a temporary grant program for certain retailers that sell donated goods and to make an appropriation.

title: Establish Law Student Encouragement Scholarship Pilot Program
description: To establish the Law Student Encouragement Scholarship Pilot Program and to make an appropriation.

title: Restrict sex offender from residing, loitering near victim's home
description: To amend sections 1923.02, 2950.99, 5321.03, and 5321.051; to amend, for the purpose of adopting a new section number as indicated in parentheses, section 2950.035 (2950.036); and to enact section 2950.035 of the Revised Code to prohibit a sex offender or a child-victim offender from residing within 2,000 feet of the residence of the victim and from loitering within 1,000 feet of the residence of the victim.

title: Increase the homestead exemption amount and income limit
description: To amend sections 323.152 and 4503.065 of the Revised Code to increase the homestead exemption amount and income limit.

title: Designate Cardiovascular Health Awareness Day
description: To enact section 5.2540 of the Revised Code to designate February 14 as "Cardiovascular Health Awareness Day."

title: Revise non-recourse litigation funding agreement regulations
description: To enact sections 1357.01, 1357.011, 1357.02, 1357.03, 1357.04, 1357.05, 1357.06, 1357.07, 1357.08, 1357.09, and 1357.10 and to repeal section 1349.55 of the Revised Code to revise and supplement state regulations concerning non-recourse litigation funding agreements.

title: Enact Alyssa's Law
description: To enact Alyssa's Law to establish a pilot grant program for public and chartered nonpublic schools to purchase panic alert systems or contract for artificial intelligence firearm detection software and to make an appropriation.

title: Enact the Platinum Providers Act
description: To amend section 122.1710 and to enact sections 122.1712 and 122.1713 of the Revised Code to modify the Individual Microcredential Assistance Program(IMAP), to create platinum provider programs for certain IMAP participants, and to name this act the Platinum Providers Act.

title: Enact the Self-Defense Protection Act
description: To amend section 2901.05 of the Revised Code to enact the Self-Defense Protection Act to create a pretrial procedure for a person asserting self-defense, defense of another, or defense of that person's property.

title: Regards local regulation, taxing of short-term rental properties
description: To amend sections 351.01, 351.021, 353.06, 4735.11, 5739.01, 5739.08, 5739.09, 5739.091, and 5741.01 and to enact section 5325.01 of the Revised Code to limit the authority of local governments to regulate short-term rental properties, to extend local lodging taxes to short-term rentals, to require collection of those taxes by short-term rental platforms, and to require real estate licenses to be issued electronically.

title: Increase the penalty for repeat voyeurism
description: To amend section 2907.08 of the Revised Code to increase the penalty for repeat voyeurism.

title: Impose additional fine for high-speed drivers
description: To amend section 4511.21 of the Revised Code to impose an additional fine on drivers who exceed the speed limit by 30 miles per hour.

title: Enact the Conscientious Right to Refuse Act
description: To enact section 3792.09 of the Revised Code to prohibit discrimination against an individual for the refusal of certain medical interventions for reasons of conscience, including religious convictions, and to name this act the Conscientious Right to Refuse Act.

title: Regards annexation and financial disclosure forms, tax exemptions
description: To amend sections 102.02, 709.022, 709.023, 709.024, 709.16, and 3735.67 and to enact section 3311.222 of the Revised Code to modify the law regarding annexation and financial disclosure forms, and to require school district approval of residential community reinvestment area property tax exemptions.

title: Regards age requirements for kindergarten admission
description: To amend section 3321.01 of the Revised Code regarding age requirements for kindergarten admission and to correct a scoring error on the 2024-2025 science end-of-course exam.

title: Enact the E-Check Ease Act
description: To amend sections 3704.14, 4503.10, 4503.102, and 4503.103 of the Revised Code to create an alternative method to certify compliance with the E-Check program and to name this act the E-Check Ease Act.

title: Enact the Ohio Blockchain Basics Act
description: To amend sections 301.30, 504.04, 715.013, 718.01, 1315.01, and 5747.01 and to enact sections 1352.01, 1352.02, 1352.03, and 1352.04 of the Revised Code to enact the Ohio Blockchain Basics Act to address mining, taxation, and regulation of digital assets.

title: Enact The Pledge of Allegiance Act
description: To amend sections 3313.602, 3314.03, 3326.11, and 3328.24 and to enact section 3313.6031 of the Revised Code to enact The Pledge of Allegiance Act to require the Pledge of Allegiance in schools.

title: Revise the lead testing, certification, and tax credit law
description: To amend sections 3742.01, 3742.03, 3742.39, 3742.50, 5747.08, 5747.26, 5747.50, 5747.502, 5747.51, 5747.53, and 5747.98 and to enact sections 3742.47 and 5747.504 of the Revised Code to revise the law governing lead testing, certification, and tax credits.

title: Enact the Graduation Readiness and Development (GRAD) Act
description: To amend sections 3314.03, 3326.11, and 3328.24 and to enact sections 5.2322 and 3313.475 of the Revised Code to enact the Graduation Readiness and Development (GRAD) Act regarding exit orientation programs at public high schools and to designate September as "Workforce Development Month."

title: Exempt from sales and use tax sales of firearm safety devices
description: To amend sections 5739.01, 5739.02, 5739.03, and 5739.17 of the Revised Code to exempt from sales and use tax sales of firearm safety devices.

title: Declare certain natural gas producers are not public utilities

Act.

description: To enact section 6101.162 of the Revised Code to prohibit a conservancy district's board of directors from including certain provisions, such as an indemnification clause, in a contract for the procurement of goods or services.

title: Modify the laws related to transportation network companies
description: To amend sections 2307.71, 4925.04, and 4925.09 of the Revised Code to modify the laws related to transportation network companies.

title: Codify the Spearin doctrine in public construction contracts
description: To enact section 4113.63 of the Revised Code to codify the Spearin doctrine in public construction contracts.

title: Name Spc. 4th Class Frank A. Herda, Medal of Honor Rec. Mem Hwy
description: To enact section 5534.856 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of State Route 94 in Cuyahoga County as the "Specialist Fourth Class Frank A. Herda, Medal of Honor Recipient, Memorial Highway."

title: Modify the law governing property taxes and other local taxes
description: To amend sections 323.12, 323.13, 325.31, 4503.06, 5709.56, and 5713.01 and to enact sections 323.123 and 5705.171 of the Revised Code to modify the law governing property taxes and other local taxes.

title: Require public body to allow public comment before taking action
description: To amend section 121.22 of the Revised Code to require a public body to allow for public commentary and testimony before taking formal action on any item.

title: Dissolve existing academic distress commissions and repeal law
description: To amend sections 133.06, 3302.036, 3302.042, 3302.043, 3302.12, 3302.17, 3310.03, 3311.29, and 3314.102 and to repeal sections 3302.10, 3302.103, 3302.11, and 3302.111 of the Revised Code to dissolve existing academic distress commissions, to repeal the law that creates new commissions, and to declare an emergency.

title: Issue medical marijuana processor cultivation, dispensary license
description: To amend sections 3780.10, 3780.13, 3796.07, 3796.14, 3796.19, and 3796.21 of the Revised Code to issue cultivation and dispensary licenses for certain medical marijuana processors.

title: Regards credit union share guaranty corporations
description: To amend section 1761.10 of the Revised Code regarding credit union share guaranty corporations.

title: Modify tax enforcement authority
description: To amend sections 5703.42, 5703.52, 5703.60, 5703.70, 5717.01, 5717.011, and 5717.02 and to enact section 5717.021 of the Revised Code to modify the tax enforcement authority of the department of taxation and the board of tax appeals.

description: To amend sections 2913.02 and 2929.14 of the Revised Code to enact the Retail Theft Prevention Act to prohibit groups acting in concert to commit retail theft.

title: Require BMV translate the Digest of Motor Vehicle Laws
description: To enact section 4507.113 of the Revised Code to require the Bureau of Motor Vehicles to translate the Digest of Motor Vehicle Laws into additional languages.

title: Enact the Ohio Capital Gains Tax Repeal Act
description: To amend sections 718.01 and 5747.01 and to repeal section 5747.79 of the Revised Code to exempt capital gains from state and municipal income taxation and to name this act the Ohio Capital Gains Tax Repeal Act.

title: Create the Chillicothe Paints license plate

title: Authorize board of elections to meet by video conference
description: To amend section 3501.09 of the Revised Code to authorize a board of elections to conduct meetings by video conference or any other similar electronic technology.

title: Prohibit financing the purchase of a dog or cat
description: To amend section 1321.44 and to enact sections 1317.081, 1321.142, 1321.412, 1321.593, and 1321.633 of the Revised Code to prohibit financing the purchase of a dog or cat.

title: Alter the law governing the regulation of pet stores

title: Enact the Student Athlete Mobility (SAM) Act
description: To enact section 3313.5321 of the Revised Code to enact the Student Athlete Mobility (SAM) Act regarding student petitions to participate in team sports at neighboring public schools.

title: Require courts to supply electronic notification of hearings
description: To enact section 2709.01 of the Revised Code to require courts to supply electronic notification of hearings to defendants in criminal and traffic cases and to make an appropriation.

title: Allow county commissioners to disapprove scenic river designation
description: To amend section 1517.14 of the Revised Code to allow a board of county commissioners to disapprove of certain scenic river designations.

title: License artificial intelligence risk mitigation organizations
description: To enact sections 3755.01, 3755.02, 3755.03, 3755.04, 3755.041, 3755.05, 3755.06, 3755.07, 3755.08, 3755.09, 3755.091, 3755.10, 3755.11, and 3755.12 of the Revised Code to create an independent verification organization license for verifying artificial intelligence risk mitigation.

description: To amend sections 339.78, 339.81, 1751.91, 3923.89, 4729.01, and 4729.39 and to enact sections 4729.21 and 4729.211 of the Revised Code to authorize pharmacists to treat minor health conditions and to name this act the Pharmacist Prescribing Authority Act.

title: Regards police escorts for farm equipment, agricultural vehicles
description: To amend section 4513.34 of the Revised Code regarding police escorts for farm equipment and vehicles that haul agricultural equipment and produce.

title: Regards underage possession, consumption, purchase of marijuana
description: To amend sections 3796.06 and 3796.99 of the Revised Code to modify prohibitions regarding underage possession, consumption, and purchase of marijuana.

description: To amend sections 4507.01, 4507.06, 4507.13, 4507.51, and 4507.52 of the Revised Code to allow a driver's license and a state identification card to indicate that the licensee or cardholder is a Gold Star Family member.

title: Regards eligibility to participate in interscholastic athletics
description: To amend section 3313.64 and to enact section 3313.5321 of the Revised Code regarding eligibility to participate in interscholastic athletics.

Enact the Auto Insurance Transparency Act

title: Regards use of recycled asphalt roofing shingles for construction
description: To enact section 3710.30 of the Revised Code to allow a person to use recycled asphalt roofing shingles for construction purposes so long as the shingles do not contain asbestos.

title: Designate President Donald Trump Freedom Highway
description: To enact section 5534.59 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of I-70 in Franklin County as the "President Donald Trump Freedom Highway."

title: Revise the law governing household sewage treatment systems
description: To amend sections 3718.02, 3718.021, 3718.11, 6111.44, and 6111.441 of the Revised Code to make changes to the law governing household sewage treatment systems.

title: Enact the Trails and Tails Act
description: To require the Department of Natural Resources to conduct two comprehensive studies on elk reintroduction and side-by-side trail expansion, to name this act the Trails and Tails Act, and to make an appropriation.

title: Remove limit on certain tax net operating loss carry-forwards
description: To amend sections 718.01, 718.81, and 718.84 of the Revised Code to remove a five-year limit on municipal income tax net operating loss carry-forwards.

description: To amend section 3310.032 of the Revised Code to limit the EdChoice expansion scholarship to families with a federal adjusted gross income of $500,000 or less.

title: Create Higher Ed Evidence-Based Innovation Fund, Grant Program
description: To enact section 3333.1211 of the Revised Code to create the Higher Education Evidence-Based Innovation Fund and Grant Program.

title: Require the use of zero-based budgeting every ten years
description: To amend sections 107.03, 126.02, 126.13, and 126.27 and to enact section 126.025 of the Revised Code to require the use of zero-based budgeting in the development of the state budget every ten years.

title: Create the Data Center Study Commission
description: To create the Data Center Study Commission.

description: To amend sections 5104.042, 5104.30, 5104.32, and 5104.34 and to enact section 109.44 of the Revised Code and to amend Sections 423.10, as subsequently amended, and 423.105 of H.B. 96 of the 136th General Assembly to revise the law governing the publicly funded child care program, modify an appropriation for the Child Care Cred Program, and to make an appropriation for a data analytics project.

description: To amend sections 5104.015 and 5104.04 and to enact sections 5104.044, 5104.303, 5104.304, and 5104.361 of the Revised Code to require video surveillance of child care centers, to establish an online portal for tracking child care center attendance, to require investigations of waste, fraud, and abuse allegations relating to providers of publicly funded child care, and to name this act the Child Care Fraud Prevention Act.

description: To establish the Frontier Technologies and Quantum Commission.

title: Regulate the use of pricing algorithms

title: Establish the Ohio Tech Institute

title: Add Inspector General, Deputy IG to definition of peace officer
description: To amend sections 109.71, 109.77, 121.483, and 2935.01 of the Revised Code to add the Inspector General and a deputy Inspector General to the definition of "peace officer" while either official is engaged in the scope of the official's duties.

title: Align and modernize fingerprinting and disposition reporting

title: Establish penalties for failing to obey a school crossing guard

title: Enact the Community and Police Protection Act
description: To enact section 2921.50 of the Revised Code to enact the Community and Police Protection Act to regulate law enforcement officers' use of masks.

title: Revise the household sewage treatment system law
description: To amend sections 3718.02, 3718.021, 3718.11, 6111.44, and 6111.441 of the Revised Code to make changes to the law governing household sewage treatment systems.

title: Enact the Affirming Families First Act
Regards liens, conservatorships - state universities and colleges

title: CA:Reconcile same sex marriage law; right to interracial marriage

title: CA: Prohibit slavery, involuntary servitude as criminal penalty
description: Proposing to amend Section 6 of Article I of the Constitution of the State of Ohio to prohibit slavery or involuntary servitude in Ohio for the punishment of crime.

title: CA: Limit property taxes to specified percentage of value
description: Proposing to amend Section 2 of Article XII of the Constitution of the State of Ohio to limit property taxes, whether voted or unvoted, to one and one-quarter per cent or, for certain owner-occupied homes, one per cent of real property's true value.

title: CA: Exempt owner-occupied residences from property tax

title: Expedite unauthorized occupant removal; prohibit fraudulent deeds
description: To amend section 2909.07 and to enact sections 1923.16 and 2913.53 of the Revised Code to provide for the expedited removal of unauthorized occupants from residential property and to prohibit the use and sale of fraudulent deeds.

title: Revise building inspection law
description: To amend sections 3781.19 and 3781.20 and to enact section 3781.21 of the Revised Code to make changes to the law relating to building inspections.

title: Regards student instruction on harmful effects of substance use

title: Prohibit paid public employee leave for certain union activities
description: To enact section 4117.091 of the Revised Code to prohibit a public employer from providing paid leave or compensation for a public employee to engage in certain union activities.

title: Incorporate Internal Revenue Code changes into Ohio law
description: To amend sections 5701.11 and 5747.01 of the Revised Code to expressly incorporate changes in the Internal Revenue Code since March 7, 2025, into Ohio law and to declare an emergency.

title: Revise non-recourse litigation funding agreement regulations
description: To enact sections 1357.01, 1357.011, 1357.02, 1357.03, 1357.04, 1357.05, 1357.06, 1357.07, and 1357.08 and to repeal section 1349.55 of the Revised Code to revise and supplement state regulations concerning non-recourse litigation funding agreements.

title: Prohibit post-employment agreement restraining career or business
description: To enact sections 4119.01, 4119.02, 4119.03, and 4119.04 of the Revised Code to prohibit agreements that restrain engaging in a lawful profession or business after the conclusion of an employment relationship.

title: Regards community foundation charitable and institutional funds

title: Designate 6888th Central Postal Directory Battalion Day

title: Designate Cardiovascular Health Awareness Day

title: Regards academic intervention, math improvement and intervention

title: Designate Ohio Stroke Awareness Week
description: To enact section 5.2540 of the Revised Code to designate the first week of May as "Ohio Stroke Awareness Week."

title: Designate Rutherford B. Hayes Day
description: To enact section 5.2322 of the Revised Code to designate October 4 as "Rutherford B. Hayes Day."

title: Revise the Alcohol Franchise Law
description: To amend section 1333.82 of the Revised Code to revise the Alcohol Franchise Law.

title: Adopt the 1905 Wright Flyer III as the state airplane
description: To enact section 5.022 of the Revised Code to adopt the 1905 Wright Flyer III as the state airplane.

title: Prohibit sun lamp tanning services to individuals under age 16
description: To amend sections 4713.50, 4713.51, and 4713.64 of the Revised Code to prohibit the provision of sun lamp tanning services to individuals under age 16.

title: Create the Joint Law Enforcement Oversight Committee
description: To enact sections 103.52 and 103.53 of the Revised Code to create the Joint Law Enforcement Oversight Committee and to make an appropriation.

title: Designate Ameloblastoma Awareness Day
description: To enact section 5.2540 of the Revised Code to designate March 20th as "Ameloblastoma Awareness Day."

title: Levy a tax on certain high-volume landlords
Allow municipalities create joint economic development district

title: Require retail merchants to give customers the option to pay cash
description: To enact section 1333.97 of the Revised Code to require retail merchants to give customers the option to pay by cash.

title: Replace interstate construction requirement with a traffic study
description: To repeal section 5501.60 of the Revised Code to replace the requirement that the Department of Transportation construct certain interstate interchanges with a traffic congestion study.

title: Establish the Child Care Cred Program
description: To enact section 5180.41 of the Revised Code to establish the Child Care Cred Program and to make an appropriation.

title: Allow employers to post certain labor law notices on the internet
description: To amend sections 4109.08, 4111.09, 4112.07, 4115.07, 4123.54, 4123.83, and 4167.11 of the Revised Code to allow employers to post certain labor law notices on the internet.

title: Enact the Historical Educational Displays Act
description: To amend sections 3314.03, 3326.11, and 3328.24 and to enact section 3313.802 of the Revised Code to enact the Display of Founding Documents of Historic Significance Act regarding the display of certain historical documents in public schools.

title: Regards supported decision-making for certain disabled adults
description: To enact sections 5123.68, 5123.681, 5123.682, 5123.683, 5123.684, 5123.685, and 5123.686 of the Revised Code to establish supported decision-making as a less restrictive alternative to guardianship for adults with developmental disabilities.

title: Revise the law governing the practice of optometry
Require presidential primary election to be held on specified day
description: To amend section 3501.01 of the Revised Code to require a presidential primary election to be held on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in May.

title: Establish liability standard for certain food-related injuries
description: To enact section 2307.56 of the Revised Code to provide for a reasonable expectation test in determining liability for injury caused by consumption of food containing a substance injurious to health and for the jury to make that determination.

title: Provide for informational poster on veteran benefits and services
description: To enact section 4113.13 of the Revised Code regarding the creation and display of a poster containing information on benefits and services for veterans.

title: Authorize tax credit for pregnancy resource center donations
description: To amend sections 5747.98 and 5751.98 and to enact sections 5747.74 and 5751.56 of the Revised Code to authorize a nonrefundable tax credit for donations to certain pregnancy resource centers and maternity homes.

title: Designate Day of Tears
description: To enact section 5.57 of the Revised Code to designate January 22 as the "Day of Tears."

title: Authorize residential stability zones with property tax exemption
description: To amend sections 4503.06, 5713.07, 5713.08, and 5715.27 and to enact sections 5709.29 and 5709.99 of the Revised Code to authorize local governments to create residential stability zones where homeowners may qualify for a partial property tax exemption.

title: Repeal the authorization of a special county lodging tax
description: To amend section 5739.09 of the Revised Code to repeal the authorization of a special county lodging tax.

title: Allow students to concurrently receive certain state scholarships
description: To amend sections 3310.034, 3310.51, and 3310.52 of the Revised Code to permit students to concurrently receive an Educational Choice scholarship or Pilot Project scholarship and either an Autism or Jon Peterson Special Needs scholarship and to make an appropriation.

title: Expand eligibility for county sewer discounted rates or charges
description: To amend section 6117.02 of the Revised Code to expand eligibility for county sewer discounted rates or charges.

title: Add screening awareness to Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month
description: To amend section 5.2219 of the Revised Code to add screening awareness to Colorectal Cancer Awareness Month.

description: To amend sections 3332.031, 3333.046, 4709.05, and 4713.07 and to enact section 3314.033 of the Revised Code to require disclosure of the for-profit status of community school operators and post-secondary educational institutions on various promotional materials and contracts for employment.

description: To amend section 117.113 of the Revised Code regarding the auditing of chartered nonpublic schools.

title: Regards right of first refusal-acquiring school district property
description: To amend sections 3313.41, 3318.08, and 5705.10; to enact new section 3313.411; and to repeal sections 3313.411, 3313.412, and 3313.413 of the Revised Code to eliminate the right of first refusal for certain schools in the acquisition of school district real property.

title: Regards age and schooling certificates, minor work hours

description: To enact section 4141.433 of the Revised Code to establish legislative oversight of executive action regarding voluntary federal unemployment compensation programs.

description: To amend section 4740.99 and to enact section 4740.18 of the Revised Code to establish a certification for specialty residential construction contractors.

description: To amend sections 107.036, 5739.02, 5747.98, and 5751.98 and to enact sections 122.1712, 5747.053, and 5751.56 of the Revised Code to exempt from the sales and use tax the sale of certain firearms and ammunition and to authorize refundable tax credits for small arms and ammunition manufacturing projects.

title: Establish veterinarian telehealth visit requirements, procedures
description: To amend section 4741.04 and to enact section 4741.041 of the Revised Code to establish requirements and procedures for veterinarian telehealth visits.

title: Regards courts and court procedures
Enact the School Bus Safety Act

description: To amend sections 3501.01, 3513.05, 3513.262, 3513.263, and 5747.502 and to enact sections 3505.011, 3513.141, 5747.504, and 5747.505 of the Revised Code to generally prohibit the use of ranked choice voting, to withhold Local Government Fund distributions from a municipality or chartered county that uses ranked choice voting, and to make changes to election petition records.

title: Increase penalties for companion animal cruelty offenses
description: To amend sections 955.54 and 959.99 and to enact section 959.23 of the Revised Code to increase the penalties for violating companion animal cruelty offenses and to prohibit a felony animal abuse offender from owning a companion animal in certain circumstances.

title: Revise product contracts, vehicle agreements, motor vehicle laws
description: To amend sections 1317.05, 3905.426, 4509.06, and 4509.70 and to enact section 1310.251 of the Revised Code to modify the law governing ancillary product protection contracts, vehicle value protection agreements, and uninsured drivers.

description: To amend section 319.301 of the Revised Code to include emergency levies, substitute levies, all inside millage, and school district income taxes in the calculation of a school district's effective millage floor.

description: To amend sections 5107.05, 5107.10, and 5107.20 of the Revised Code regarding the pass-through of support payments under the Ohio Works First program.

description: To amend sections 3317.02, 3317.022, 3317.03, and 5747.75 and to enact sections 3310.21, 3310.22, 3310.23, 3310.24, 3310.25, and 3310.26 of the Revised Code to establish the Nonchartered Educational Savings Account Program and to make an appropriation.

title: Reform the state's public retirement system law
description: To declare the General Assembly's intent to enact legislation to reform the law governing the state's public retirement systems.

title: Enact the Ohio Fairness Act
description: To amend sections 4112.01 and 4112.05 of the Revised Code to enact the Ohio Fairness Act to prohibit discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation or gender identity or expression, to add mediation as an informal method that the Ohio Civil Rights Commission may use, and to uphold existing religious exemptions under Ohio's Civil Rights Law.

title: Prohibit conversion therapy for minors by certain professionals
description: To enact sections 4723.95, 4731.45, 4732.34, 4743.11, 4757.46, and 4758.73 of the Revised Code to prohibit certain licensed health care professionals from engaging in conversion therapy for minor patients.

title: Regards filing false claims with the state, defrauding the state
description: To enact sections 2749.01, 2749.02, 2749.03, 2749.04, 2749.05, 2749.06, 2749.07, 2749.08, 2749.09, and 2749.10 of the Revised Code regarding filing false or fraudulent claims with the state and defrauding the state of money or property.

title: Enact Creating a Respectful and Open World for Natural Hair Act
description: To amend sections 3314.03, 3326.11, 3328.24, and 4112.01 and to enact section 3313.6612 of the Revised Code to enact the Creating a Respectful and Open World for Natural Hair (CROWN) Act to prohibit discrimination against an individual based on hair texture and protective hair styles.

title: Create the fair paycheck workplace certificate
description: To enact sections 4145.01, 4145.02, 4145.03, 4145.04, 4145.05, and 4145.06 of the Revised Code to create the fair paycheck workplace certificate.

title: Increase penalty for failure to report a lost or stolen firearm
description: To amend section 2923.20 of the Revised Code to increase the penalty for failure to report a lost or stolen firearm.

title: Regards the debarment of state vendors
description: To amend sections 125.25, 153.02, and 5513.06 of the Revised Code regarding the debarment of state vendors.

title: Require a system to anonymously report wage discrimination
description: To enact section 4112.041 of the Revised Code to require the Ohio Civil Rights Commission to establish a system for individuals to anonymously report wage discrimination.

title: Establish and operate the Ohio Health Care Plan
description: To amend section 109.02 and to enact sections 3920.01, 3920.02, 3920.03, 3920.04, 3920.05, 3920.06, 3920.07, 3920.08, 3920.09, 3920.10, 3920.11, 3920.12, 3920.13, 3920.14, 3920.15, 3920.21, 3920.22, 3920.23, 3920.24, 3920.25, 3920.26, 3920.27, 3920.28, 3920.31, 3920.32, and 3920.33 of the Revised Code to establish and operate the Ohio Health Care Plan to provide universal health care coverage to all Ohio residents.

description: To amend section 1327.70 of the Revised Code to authorize a county to implement a motor fuel quality testing program.

description: To amend section 149.43 of the Revised Code to specify that certain election officials are designated public service workers for purposes of the public records law.

title: Revise eviction, code enforcement, and real property transfer law
description: To amend sections 319.20, 1923.06, 1923.08, 1923.09, 3781.10, and 5321.17 and to enact sections 120.522, 120.531, 319.204, 1923.111, 1923.16, and 3781.181 of the Revised Code to revise the law governing eviction, residential building code enforcement, and real property transfers.

title: Define antisemitism; expand the offense of ethnic intimidation
description: To amend sections 2927.12 and 4112.01 and to enact sections 124.92 and 4112.20 of the Revised Code to define antisemitism for specific purposes and to expand the offense of ethnic intimidation to include the offenses of riot and aggravated riot committed by reason of the race, color, religion, or national origin of another person or group of persons.

title: Enact the Ohio Property Protection Act
description: To amend sections 319.202, 5301.256, and 5323.02 of the Revised Code to modify the law that prohibits certain governments, businesses, and individuals from acquiring certain real property and to name this act the Ohio Property Protection Act.

description: To amend section 5747.01 of the Revised Code to authorize a personal income tax deduction for gym memberships and personal training.

description: To amend sections 4503.038, 4503.19, and 5502.68 and to enact sections 4503.261 and 4503.262 of the Revised Code to authorize a contract with a private vendor for the issuance of specialty license plates.

description: To amend sections 323.152 and 4503.065 of the Revised Code to authorize a total property tax exemption for the homesteads of totally disabled veterans and their surviving spouses.

description: To declare the General Assembly's intent to establish a new school financing system that provides a statewide per-pupil funding payment to public and chartered nonpublic schools based on a single statewide property tax and increased state sales tax.

description: To enact section 3345.88 of the Revised Code regarding broadcasts of intercollegiate athletic competitions.

title: Designate Chief of Police James G. Jackson Memorial Highway

description: To amend sections 5747.08 and 5747.98 and to enact sections 5747.87 and 5747.88 of the Revised Code to authorize a nonrefundable income tax credit for the cost of handgun training and firearms storage and locking devices.

title: Double fines for failing to yield to a funeral procession
description: To amend section 4511.451 of the Revised Code to double fines for failing to yield to a funeral procession.

Allow alternative rate plans for certain natural gas companies

title: Enact Alyssa's Law
description: To amend sections 3314.03, 3326.11, and 3328.24 and to enact section 3313.88 of the Revised Code to enact Alyssa's Law to require public and chartered nonpublic schools to implement a wearable panic alert system and to make an appropriation.

title: Regulate the ownership of electric vehicle charging stations
description: To amend sections 4928.01, 4928.03, and 4928.041 of the Revised Code regarding electric vehicle charging stations.

description: To amend sections 3501.01, 3505.03, 3505.04, 3513.254, 3513.255, 3513.256, and 3513.259 of the Revised Code to require state and school district board members to appear on the ballot with a party designation.

title: Provide no-cost breakfast and lunch to students
description: To amend sections 3301.91 and 3313.819 of the Revised Code to provide breakfast and lunch at no cost to public and chartered nonpublic school students, and to make an appropriation.

title: Modify tax credits under the rural business growth program
description: To amend sections 122.15, 122.151, 122.152, 122.153, 122.154, 122.155, 5725.98, and 5729.98 of the Revised Code to modify the availability of and eligibility for tax credits awarded under the rural business growth program.

title: Designate Henrietta Lacks Day
description: To enact section 5.2322 of the Revised Code to designate October 4th as "Henrietta Lacks Day."

title: Establish appointment procedures for constitutional convention
description: To enact sections 3523.13, 3523.14, 3523.15, 3523.16, 3523.17, 3523.18, and 3523.99 of the Revised Code to establish procedures for appointing delegates to a convention of the states under Article V of the United States Constitution.

title: Prohibit diversity, equity, and inclusion in public schools

title: Prohibit law enforcement from using quotas for arrests, citations

title: Reduce tangible personal property tax for pipe-line companies
description: To amend section 5727.111 of the Revised Code to reduce the tangible personal property tax assessment rate for pipe-line companies.

title: Regulate the provision of earned wage access services

title: Designate the Freedom Parkway
description: To enact section 5534.967 of the Revised Code to designate a portion of U.S. Route 36 in Delaware County as the "Freedom Parkway."

title: Establish the Urban Farmer Youth Initiative Pilot Program
description: To amend sections 3781.06, 3781.061, and 5713.30 of the Revised Code relating to temporary greenhouses and building codes, to establish the Urban Farmer Youth Initiative Pilot Program, to codify certain property tax requirements for agricultural land, and to make an appropriation.

title: Designate Counseling Awareness Month
description: To enact section 5.2322 of the Revised Code to designate April as "Counseling Awareness Month."

title: Designate Arab American Heritage Month

title: Clarify that child independent activity is not abuse or neglect

title: CA: Eliminate prohibition against taxing food and beverages
